segments.title: Kissinger Obituary with Liliana
segments.notes: Case opens without transitions; Liliana delivers a sexually charged eulogy for Henry Kissinger, praising his 'power daddy' energy while reading The Intercept's war-crimes tally; Case cuts her off after she fantasizes about 'sexy hell.'

segments.title: Tech Issues & Randy Orton Diversion
segments.notes: Case troubleshoots missing scene transitions, shows Randy Orton's physique, reads top underwriters and new subs, confirms Lethal Company session with Fiona later.

segments.title: Masturbation World Record Deep-Dive
segments.notes: Chet interrupts to analyze Drake Hardy's 10-hour-10-minute claim, details 'mood music, mood lighting, partial tumescence' method, debates ref requirements and 'gooning' vs. raw endurance, signs off with a freestyle 'never quit jerking' chant.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Trailer Thursday
segments.notes: Trent hosts without his contractual fire transition; reviews Obliterated (Netflix), Pokemon Horizons, and TM robot-thriller trailer; debates review fairness with Case; multistream audio issues persist.

segments.title: Kelce Brothers Debate (Poll Glitched)
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate Travis vs. Jason Kelce; multistream poll desync yields a 50-50 deadlock; Crum argues for Jason's traditional values, Munch for Travis's Swift-fueled fame; segment ends in 'crumb believable' banter.

segments.title: Lethal Company with Fi, Malco, Exterminator & Kendelle
segments.notes: Extended gameplay session: crew cycles through moons (Assurance, Offense, Val), battles bunker spiders, eyeless dogs, forest giants, turrets, quicksand; buys inverse teleporter, apparatus, air horn, pro flashlights; meets 239 quota after multiple wipes; ends with raid to Ricky Peacock.

lore_notes.fact: Case's scene transition system completely deleted, forcing 'barely functional news' without transitions.
Multistream poll desync causes Munch & Crum Kelce debate to deadlock 50-50 with 100 votes.
Lethal Company inverse teleporter introduced: 3.5-min cooldown, teleports whole crew outside ship, drops items at teleporter.
Broadcast ends with raid to Ricky Peacock.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a transition-free broadcast covering Henry Kissinger's death with Liliana's unconventional mourning, a Chet Guy the Science Eyes deep-dive on masturbation endurance records, a fire-transition-less Trent at the Movies, a multistream-glitched Munch & Crum Kelce debate, and an extended Lethal Company session where Case, Fiona, Malco, Exterminator, and Kendelle narrowly met quota before being nuked by an alien ship.
